`icd11-sample.txt` is an unmodified extract of the WHO ICD-11 MMS SimpleTabulation, release 2025-01, used for importer tests only.

Source: World Health Organization, ICD-11 for Mortality and Morbidity Statistics. Licensed under CC BY-ND 3.0 IGO.

`country-sample.csv` is an extract of datahub.io/core/country-codes, licensed ODC-PDDL-1.0.

`lgd/chandigarh.zip` and `lgd/lakshadweep.zip` are unmodified state exports from the Local Government Directory (lgdirectory.gov.in), Ministry of Panchayati Raj, Government of India, published as open government data under NDSAP. They are used for importer tests only.
